title: round 1 operator-observed: calibration bands carry no token dimension — first live round runs 350-450k downstream tokens against a band that cannot express it
description: Operator-observed during round 1's live dispatch (2026-07-21), watching the harness agent monitor. Evidence: the round-1 manifest on #673 declared its expected band as 'cold-spec-review-round, 3 to 15 findings' — the adopted band (economics-data.md, calibration_bands) is denominated in findings and wall-clock only; the contract's cost denomination ('tokens by cache class' among the native units) has no member in the band data. Observed actuals, capture-source harness task telemetry: quality-engineer lens 71,732 tokens; ux lens 50,948; the three remaining lenses at 70.7k-111.9k mid-run per the operator's monitor — roughly 350-450k downstream tokens for one five-lens round, in an estate whose amendment history runs 8-22 rounds. Root shape: each cold lens independently reads its domain prompt, governing-contract sections, and all nine artifacts — five uncached contexts, input-dominated. Disposition candidates for triage (operator has not yet ruled): (a) add a token dimension to the bands now, seeded from these first actuals; (b) leave bands as-is and let Layer 9's ledger own the dimension, recording actuals per round meanwhile; (c) structural cost reduction for later rounds — per-set lens briefs over the retrieval-shaped artifacts instead of all-nine reads, fewer lenses per round per the review-budget rule; (d) re-denominate by what binds under the session's auth mode (window and operator-time), per the adopted attribution grain. Owner: ai-engineer. Validator: solution-owner (band data is operator-adopted oracle territory).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 1 FINAL COST ACTUALS (all five lenses complete; capture source: harness task telemetry — total tokens, runtime, tool-use count per agent; the vehicle exposes NO cache-class or input/output split, and none is fabricated): quality-engineer 71,732 tokens / 6m21s / 10 tool uses; ux 50,948 / 7m24s / 22; solution-owner 127,581 / 11m6s / 29; solution-architect 124,746 / 11m38s / 24; documentation-reviewer 105,111 / 12m47s / 33. ROUND TOTAL: 480,118 downstream tokens, ~13 minutes wall-clock (parallel). Findings: 46 pre-dedup across five lenses — the declared band said 3-15, so both band dimensions (findings AND the absent token unit) get their first honest correction from this round. DERIVED MAKEUP (measured file sizes, chars/4, labeled estimate — not observed): the governing contract is ~37k tokens read whole; the nine artifacts ~12k combined; schemas ~8k; one domain prompt ~1k. The correlation is the makeup story: the two lenses that read the whole contract (SO 127k, SA 125k) cost roughly double the two that read excerpts (UX 51k, QE 72k). The contract re-read is the price driver, per-lens, and the retrieval-shaped-artifacts clause exists precisely to license excerpt reads. CAPTURE-GRAIN STATEMENT (the attribution-grain discipline applied to the vehicle): totals and runtime are observable today; makeup is derivable-by-measurement only; true cache-class makeup requires the Claude Code telemetry surface (an operator settings act) or Layer 9's capture adapters. The operator's formulation — a system that cannot say tokens used, runtime, and makeup is not answering the questions — is a live restatement of the Cost is knowable contract's canonical questions and stands as confirming evidence for Layer 9's Cost queries criterion.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OBSERVED MAKEUP, round 1 (capture source: subagent transcript usage records, parsed by the bootstrap adapter script this comment describes — the transcripts carry per-request input/output/cache-read/cache-write): solution-architect 15.3k uncached-in / 1.65M cache-read / 650k cache-write / 51.4k out, 39 api turns, tools 22 Read + 2 Bash; solution-owner 15.3k / 3.75M / 402k / 41.3k, 56 turns, 15 Bash + 14 Read; documentation-reviewer 27.3k / 2.65M / 354k / 40.3k, 62 turns, 22 Bash + 11 Read; quality-engineer 19.0k / 472k / 235k / 25.0k, 22 turns, 10 Read; ux 18.5k / 1.10M / 104k / 25.9k, 47 turns, 17 Bash + 5 Read. THE OPTIMIZATION SIGNAL (the operator's tool-mix hypothesis confirmed): cache-read volume tracks API TURN COUNT, not artifact size — every tool call triggers a full-context cache re-read, so the 56-turn Bash-heavy solution-owner lens moved 3.75M cache tokens while the 22-turn Read-only quality-engineer lens moved 472k for comparable finding yield. Turn count and tool mix are the levers; uncached input is trivial (15-27k) and output modest (25-51k) everywhere. CAPTURE DISCREPANCY, recorded per the provenance discipline: the harness notification figure (e.g. quality-engineer 71,732) matches no simple combination of the transcript usage fields — two capture sources, two numbers, definitions to be pinned before either enters a band. Signal candidates for the effort/optimization catalog (AI Engineer owned): api-turn count per dispatch; tool-mix ratio (search-shaped Bash vs whole-file Read); cache-read per turn (context growth); cache-write (context accumulated); output per finding. Bootstrap adapter: a ~30-line transcript parser, run per round — no conduct change required to measure, per the operator's observe-first ruling.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DOCUMENTED PRICING WEIGHTS APPLIED TO OBSERVED USAGE (capture: transcript usage records; rates: Anthropic API documentation via the claude-api reference — Opus 4.8 $5/M input, $25/M output, cache read 0.1x input, cache write 1.25x input at 5-minute TTL): per-lens API-equivalent cost — solution-architect $6.25 (cache-write dominates: $4.06 of it), solution-owner $5.50, documentation-reviewer $4.68, quality-engineer $2.43, ux $1.94. ROUND TOTAL ~$20.80 API-equivalent (under this estate's subscription auth this expresses as window consumption, not billed dollars — the attribution-grain rule — but the documented weights are the canonical ranking). STRUCTURE: cache-write (context accumulation at 1.25x) and output (25x the cache-read rate) are the expensive units; the headline multi-million cache-read numbers are the CHEAP unit (0.1x). The levers, re-ranked by documented weights: (1) context accumulated per lens (cache-write), (2) output volume incl. thinking, (3) turn count (drives cache-read AND re-writes). MODEL TIER, observed + documented: the five lenses ran claude-opus-4-8 ($5/$25); the session model (claude-fable-5) is documented at $10/$50 — exactly 2x per token. The harness already routes fan-outs to the cheaper tier; the same round on the session model would have weighed ~$41.60. Model-per-dispatch is a 2x lever and our manifest had recorded it wrong (see the #673 correction). EFFORT, documented: Claude Code defaults to xhigh on this tier; effort controls thinking depth and overall token spend (lower = fewer, more consolidated tool calls — the turn-count driver we measured); thinking bills as output tokens; the Workflow orchestration surface exposes per-agent effort (opts.effort) while the plain fan-out tool does not — so effort-controlled A/B rounds are ALREADY POSSIBLE via the workflow vehicle, a capability note for the measured-pass design.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21, round-1 triage), two members adopted, combinable candidates (a)+(c): (1) SEED THE TOKEN DIMENSION — calibration_bands gains a tokens-per-round dimension seeded from round 1's observed 480,118 downstream tokens, capture source PINNED to subagent transcript usage records (not the harness notification figure — the two-sources discrepancy stands recorded above); first honest band, corrected as rounds accumulate, same treatment the findings band gets (46 observed vs the 3-15 declared). (2) EXCERPT-READ BRIEFS for round 2 onward — dispatches carry per-set lens briefs pointing at the retrieval-shaped sections instead of all-nine-artifact reads; observed backing: the two whole-contract-read lenses (solution-owner 127.6k, solution-architect 124.7k) cost roughly double the excerpt-read lenses (ux 50.9k, quality-engineer 71.7k); the retrieval-shaped-artifacts clause exists precisely to license this. Declined for now: Layer-9-owns-it deferral (the bootstrap adapter already measures), and window/operator-time re-denomination (the attribution-grain rule already covers expression under subscription auth; API-equivalent weights stay the canonical ranking). Data-side: bands gain the dimension at the fix pass; round-2 dispatch conduct carries the briefs.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, economics-data): the cold-spec-review-round band now carries all three dimensions — findings pre-dedup widened to observed, wall-clock, and the seeded 200k-600k token dimension with capture source pinned to subagent transcript usage records and the harness-figure discrepancy excluded from band inputs; the fix-pass band states its missing token dimension honestly (attended in-session, capture awaits Layer 9 adapters). The excerpt-read-briefs conduct half is round-2 dispatch conduct: the round-2 manifest carries per-lens briefs and this issue's ruling as its authority. Closing; the bootstrap adapter and the round-2 measured pass are tracked by the loop itself (#673 sequence).
